33:t_1:4.en:
$$カヲル$$
「But there are still many unstable factors. Maybe you and I will once again...」

33:t_1:11.en:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「The other day's battle was a special exception.」

33:t_1:12.en:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Dispatching EVAs to $c will not be approved. I have already given my answer to Director $$大塚$$ of the Far East Branch.」

33:t_1:14.en:
$$ミサト$$
「But, Commander $$碇$$... With most of the world already under the control of the $$新地球皇国$$, we can't tell when they will target Japan.」

33:t_1:15.en:
$$ミサト$$
「To avoid even a little risk, wouldn't it be wiser to form a joint front with $c here?」

33:t_1:16.en:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「There is no need for that.」

33:t_1:18.en:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「There is no need for that, either.」

33:t_1:20.en:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「...Do you intend to move the EVA on your own private judgment again, like that time?」

33:t_1:21.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I'll look for something I can do without the EVA.」

33:t_1:23.en:
$$シンジ$$
「If you're going to take the EVA away from me, Father, then I won't pilot the EVA anymore.」

33:t_1:25.en:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Then I have no use for you. Get out.」

33:t_1:28.en:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「As of this moment, Unit-01 will be operated with the Dummy Plug.」

33:t_1:34.en:
$$シンジ$$
(While $$赤木$$, $$甲児$$, and everyone are fighting, I...)

33:t_1:35.en:
$$シンジ$$
(I won't rely on Father anymore... I'll look for what I can do on my own. Otherwise...)

33:t_1:38.en:
$$加持$$
「Sorry about that. That thing you asked me to look into... I couldn't manage it.」

33:t_1:40.en:
$$加持$$
「$$式波・アスカ・ラングレー$$ is still not allowed any visitors... Her condition is unknown as well.」

33:t_1:42.en:
$$加持$$
「...Looks like my words ended up being the final push for your running away from home.」

33:t_1:44.en:
$$加持$$
「I've already heard about what happened between you and Commander $$碇$$.」

33:t_1:45.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Did $$ミサト$$ ask you to come and stop me?」

33:t_1:46.en:
$$加持$$
「Sort of. ...But I have no intention of doing that.」

33:t_1:48.en:
$$加持$$
「You made this decision yourself. It's not for other people to butt in.」

33:t_1:49.en:
$$加持$$
「I'll send you off with my blessing.」

33:t_1:51.en:
$$加持$$
「Want me to drive you to $$第２新東京市$$, or to the Far East base in Izu?」

33:t_1:54.en:
$$加持$$
(What do you intend to do, Commander $$碇$$...? Are you planning to just abandon the plan in this world...?)

33:t_1:59.en:
$$シンジ$$
(People heading to school and work... Everyone has something to do...)

33:t_1:63.en:
$$ケンスケ$$
「Where are you going, man? You haven't been coming to school lately, either.」

33:t_1:64.en:
$$ケンスケ$$
「And it's not just you - $$綾波$$ and $$式波$$ aren't coming either. Are you on some kind of operation?」

33:t_1:66.en:
$$トウジ$$
「Ha-ha, I get it now. Don't tell me you miss $$第２新東京市$$, eh?」

33:t_1:68.en:
$$トウジ$$
「But with $$アマタ$$ and $$カレン$$ gone too, the Volunteer Club sounds like it's having a hard time.」

33:t_1:69.en:
$$ケンスケ$$
「Yeah, yeah. On top of that, this $$新地球皇国$$ thing is throwing its weight around.」

33:t_1:71.en:
$$トウジ$$
「Well... can't be helped. We got transferred to $$第２新東京市$$ because the school here got wrecked.」

33:t_1:72.en:
$$トウジ$$
「The school's been fixed, so coming back here is only natural, when you think about it.」

33:t_1:73.en:
$$ケンスケ$$
「We'll keep doing our thing here, $$シンジ$$. Anyway, let's just head to school like this.」

33:t_1:77.en:
$$トウジ$$
「...You were walking down this road, so you were heading to the station, right...」

33:t_1:78.en:
$$トウジ$$
「Were you going to $$第２新東京市$$?」

33:t_1:82.en:
$$トウジ$$
「We'll tell the class rep and the teacher. Go on and settle things for good.」

33:t_1:83.en:
$$ケンスケ$$
「...Yeah. I think that's the best thing to do, too.」

33:t_1:84.en:
$$ケンスケ$$
「Piloting an EVA must be rough in all sorts of ways. You probably have worries we couldn't even begin to understand...」

33:t_1:86.en:
$$ケンスケ$$
「But you weren't fighting alone, right? You had everyone from $c with you.」

33:t_1:87.en:
$$トウジ$$
「That's right. So if you're in trouble, go talk to your big brothers and sisters.」

33:t_1:88.en:
$$ケンスケ$$
「And of course, you can lean on us too. We can't give you any combat advice, though...」

33:t_1:90.en:
$$シンジ$$
「...Thank you, $$トウジ$$, $$ケンスケ$$.」

33:t_1:91.en:
$$ケンスケ$$
「When you get there, say hi to everyone in the Volunteer Club for us.」

綾波.evidence: Kensuke says 綾波 and 式波 for the EVA pilots Rei Ayanami (glossary 綾波レイ / アヤナミレイ（仮称）) and Asuka Langley Shikinami (glossary 式波・アスカ・ラングレー); surname only, so it works for either Rei

式波.evidence: Asuka Langley Shikinami's surname (glossary 式波・アスカ・ラングレー); Kaji uses the full name in 33:t_1:40, Kensuke the surname in 33:t_1:64

33:t_1:12: approver left impersonal ('will not be approved'), as in the source
33:t_1:34: Shinji's 'and I...' left unfinished, as in the source
33:t_1:54: Kaji's 'abandon the plan' - subject taken as Gendo (the addressed Commander Ikari)
uncertain: 33:t_1:34: 赤木さん - glossary has Ritsuko Akagi (female), Shunsuke Akagi (male) and plain 赤木 (male, used in dlg_2001_00 for a Volunteer Club member); used the $$赤木$$ token, which reads 'Akagi' and avoids a gender choice; could be Ritsuko

Captions 8/33/58: layout spaces copied from the brief; 8 and 33 use the $$ＮＥＲＶ$$ token (Jigoku used plain NERV), 58 uses $$第３新東京市$$ as in Jigoku; 'Far East Branch/base' and 'Dummy Plug' are my wording

33:t_1:82: 委員長 = 'class rep' and 先生 = 'the teacher' (no names in this row); ケジメをつけてこい rendered 'settle things for good'
33:t_1:87: 兄さんや姐さん達 = 'big brothers and sisters' (the $c crew)
33:t_1:12/15/86: $c used as a bare noun, following earlier slices
33:t_1:78/51: 第２新東京市 uses the proposed glossary token (Neo Tokyo-2)
